review: 404.1-2: flashback expected omitted the sacrificed Mountain going to A's graveyard; added it.

404.1-5: token variant was labelled does_not_fire, but a sacrificed token does go to the graveyard before ceasing to exist (704.5d); made it other with that outcome and added a Leyline of the Void does_not_fire variant.

scenarios.title: An instant that finished resolving is put on top of its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: A's graveyard is listed bottom first.

decisions: A casts Lava Dart targeting B, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Lava Dart resolves.

variants.label: from_hand
variants.expected: B takes 1 damage (19 life). Lava Dart goes on top of A's graveyard, above Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: flashback
variants.delta: Lava Dart is in A's graveyard on top of Grizzly Bears and A casts it with flashback, sacrificing Mountain.
variants.expected: B takes 1 damage. Lava Dart is exiled and A's graveyard holds Mountain on top of Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.title: A countered spell is put on top of its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: A's graveyard is listed bottom first.

decisions: A casts Lava Dart targeting B, tapping Mountain.
B casts Counterspell targeting Lava Dart, tapping both Islands.

variants.label: from_hand
variants.expected: Lava Dart is countered and goes on top of A's graveyard, above Grizzly Bears; Counterspell goes to B's graveyard. B takes no damage.

variants.label: flashback
variants.delta: Lava Dart is in A's graveyard on top of Grizzly Bears and A casts it with flashback, sacrificing Mountain.
variants.expected: Lava Dart is countered and exiled instead of going to the graveyard; Mountain goes on top of A's graveyard, above Grizzly Bears; Counterspell goes to B's graveyard; B takes no damage.

scenarios.title: A destroyed creature is put on top of its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: B's graveyard is listed bottom first.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: toughness_2
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears takes 2 damage and dies; it goes on top of B's graveyard, above Giant Growth. Shock goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: toughness_3
variants.delta: B's creature is Centaur Courser (3/3) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Centaur Courser stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked; B's graveyard holds only Giant Growth.

scenarios.title: A discarded card is put on top of its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: B's graveyard is listed bottom first.

decisions: A casts Raven's Crime targeting B, tapping Swamp.
Both players pass; Raven's Crime resolves.

variants.label: plain
variants.expected: Forest goes on top of B's graveyard, above Grizzly Bears; B keeps Giant Growth. Raven's Crime goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: library_of_leng
variants.delta: B controls Library of Leng and chooses to put the discarded Forest on top of their library.
variants.expected: Forest goes on top of B's library; B's graveyard holds only Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.title: A sacrificed permanent is put on top of its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: B's graveyard is listed bottom first. In the leyline_of_the_void variant, A cast Leyline of the Void after Giant Growth reached B's graveyard.

decisions: A casts Diabolic Edict targeting B, tapping both Swamps.
Both players pass; Diabolic Edict resolves.
B sacrifices Grizzly Bears, B's only creature.

variants.label: card
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears goes on top of B's graveyard, above Giant Growth.

variants.label: token
variants.delta: B's only creature is a 2/2 Bear creature token instead of the Grizzly Bears card.
variants.expected: The token is put into B's graveyard as it is sacrificed and ceases to exist in the next state-based check; B's graveyard then holds only Giant Growth.

variants.label: leyline_of_the_void
variants.delta: A controls Leyline of the Void.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is sacrificed and exiled instead of going to B's graveyard; B's graveyard holds only Giant Growth.

scenarios.forge_notes: A token named Grizzly Bears stands for a vanilla 2/2 green Bear token.
